messages:
diego.prod: Heads-up: launching a limited preview for H100S Dedicated in ca-central-1 (Montreal) with a low-latency configuration. Target audience: customers doing streaming chat, real-time agents, and low-latency RAG.

diego.prod: Why H100S-LL? Tuned for single-token latency and kernel preemption; should benefit streaming workloads and interactive agents that need consistent tail latency.

mai.eng: Tech summary: hosts are 2x H100S per server with preemptive scheduling disabled for inference lanes, faster PCIe paths enabled, and our low-latency kernel set. Internal p99 latency improved ~25% vs h100-default for 1-2 token emit patterns.

mai.eng: Note: weve disabled large batch aggregation on these nodes to favor latency; throughput for large-batch scoring will be lower vs standard H100 pools.

rachel.ops: Rollout plan: pool name h100s-ca-mtl-ll-preview. Soft-preview live now with very small quota (5 tenants). GA target ~3 weeks pending telemetry. Preview billing tag: preview-h100s-ll. No SLA in preview.

rachel.ops: Access flow: request via internal form and tag ticket here. Please avoid routing production traffic until GA.

deploy-bot: [capacity-event] created pool h100s-ca-mtl-ll-preview (pool-id: pool-h100s-mtl-01) by rachel.ops at 2026-05-18T11:12:34Z

omar.sales: Sales note: Ill send a short AE blurb emphasizing low tail latency for interactive agents and streaming chat. Limited seats; use approval workflow.

mai.eng: Ops checklist (short):
```
- Add h100s-ca-mtl-ll-preview to routing with fallback to h100-ca and a800-ca.
- Per-tenant cap = 1 host in preview; request increases via support.
- Disable large-batch aggregation and enable per-request prefetch for KV cache.
- Emit low-latency traces to a separate metric bucket for analysis.
```

mai.eng: Example redwoodctl command for reserving a node for evaluation:
```
redwoodctl reservations create --pool pool-h100s-mtl-01 --units 1 --duration 7d --justification "low-latency preview"
```

devex-lee: Ill update docs with a low-latency quickstart and suggested config (streaming=True, max_batch=1). ETA: EOD tomorrow.

rachel.ops: Action items: Mai monitor p50/p95/p99 latency and regressions; Rachel maintain preview whitelist and post weekly snapshots; Omar prepare AE comms; Billing hold GA pricing until stable telemetry. Post any customer preview requests in this thread.

rachel.ops: Pool health: GREEN (all nodes reporting)

diego.prod: Thanks all  will follow up with a short internal FAQ and access link in 24h.
